He submits that despite positive direction given by 'the Department', the District Compassionate Committee, Gaya took up the matter on 27.11.2017 and rejected his case now taking a different view that though he has been acquitted of all the charges, now that lots of time has lapsed, the compassionate appointment is provided immediately to bring the family out of the economic crisis,
nine years have lapsed no relief can be granted ( Annexure-5 to the petition).
10.
Aggrieved, the writ petition.
Patna High Court CWJC No.3372 of 2018 dt.19-09-2023 11.

It is the case of the petitioner that since his case was earlier considered but was not rejected rather kept in abeyance till the conclusion of the criminal case, it was their bounden duty to act in line with their earlier decision once the petitioner was acquitted of all the charges.
12. It is his further submission that though nine years have lapsed, fact remains that they are still suffering and are still in economic distress.

13. On the other hand, the submission of the State is in line with the decision taken by the District Compassionate Committee, Gaya inasmuch as it has been submitted that the father of the petitioner died in 2008, the decision was finally taken in 2017, nine years lapsed and as such, it cannot be said that they are in economic distress.

14. This Court fails to understand the decisions taken by the District Compassionate Committee,
Gaya under the Chairmanship of its District Magistrate.

When on 11.12.2017, the case of the petitioner was pending till the considered and it was observed to keep the same conclusion of the Ajit Ranjan Pandey vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22092204/
4 criminal case, it was clear that the District Compassionate Committee was ready to wait for years till the criminal case comes to an end.

sentences.text: 15. Once the criminal case concluded and the Patna High Court CWJC No.3372 of 2018 dt.19-09-2023 petitioner as also his mother were exonerated of the charges upon presentation of his representation, the District Magistrate, Gaya sought guidelines from 'the Department', Bihar Patna.

16. As incorporated above, 'the Department' gave a positive direction clearly stating that the case of the petitioner was not rejected rather it was kept pending and in that view, a decision can be taken on his application.

17. Ignoring its own decision taken in 2017 as also the letter no. 9991 dated 04.08.2017 of 'the Department', the District Compassionate Committee, Gaya took a different route to deny the compassionate appointment to the petitioner.
The same is totally unjustified.
18. In the said circumstances, the decision of the District Compassionate Committee, Gaya dated 27.11.2017 so far as the same relates to the petitioner stands quashed.
19. The petitioner will approach the District Magistrate, Gaya within a period of eight weeks from today alongwith his representation.

20. If such representation is filed within the aforesaid period, the District Magistrate, Gaya is duty bound to put the same before the District Compassionate Committee, Gaya in its next meeting and take a decision in accordance with law and Patna High Court CWJC No.3372 of 2018 dt.19-09-2023 convey the same to the petitioner.
21. The writ petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid observations.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Jagdish/-
